entities.title: GitHub workflows
entities.summary: The workflows that check every change, release the tools on a tag and benchmark zazzle, and the weekly dependency updates.
entities.purpose: Holds ci.yml (checks on pushes to main and pull requests), release.yml (the release of every tool on v* tags), zazzle-bench.yml (latency and refs readings for zazzle) and dependabot.yml. What each runs is in the pipeline record; the release is a use case.
boundaries: The scripts the release runs (bottle, formula, PGO training, signing) live in macos/release/, with their tests.
The Homebrew formula is pushed to the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z, not kept here.
The rules that protect main and the repository's secrets are set on GitHub, not here.

relationships.description: The scripts the release workflow runs.
